description: The spaceGaze at the Eiffel Tower above the stately facades of the 16th arrondissement from this exquisite apartment on Avenue Georges Mandel. Situated in one of the supreme examples of 19th-century Haussmannian style, this 3100-square-foot home embodies a unique mélange of artisanal contemporary artistry and vintage Parisian grace. Host a private fête from your gourmet kitchen or walk minutes to some of the finest dining in the City of Light.Top craftsmen and designers from around France created a warm symphony of the modern, classical, and naturalistic. Herringbone parquet floors of luminous oak extend from room to room, harmonizing with superb original artwork, antique wainscoting, and the earth-forged abstractions of Italian Calacatta Oro marble. Broad thresholds engender a graceful flow between the open-concept kitchen and dining area through the multi-chambered living room, with tall French doors opening to wrought-iron balconies. The apartment enjoys 80 feet of frontage above the avenue, with exposure in all directions and views of the Trocadero.Secluded within the South Wing, the ample master suite features a dressing room with 50-foot oak walls and an ensuite bathroom with marble tub, separate shower, and dual vanity. The guestrooms are located in the Northeast Wing, each with a twin bed and shared access to a bathroom with shower. Ideal for a family, the apartment is also a comfortable choice for small groups of friends, business travelers, or tennis pilgrims visiting Roland-Garros.Emerging from the building's lobby, you'll step into one of the most prestigious and inspiring neighborhoods in all of Paris. Stroll through the Jardin du Trocadero, cross the Seine, and arrive at the base of the Eiffel Tower. Visit the district's charming museums—including the Musé
